AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. A — 100 °C

3. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

5. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.

9. D — Ice melting to water

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
